props.name: series
props.description: One entry per line. Every series may have its own sample positions.

props.name: range
props.description: Controlled visible range of the detail view.

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Visible range when uncontrolled. Defaults to everything.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Called on every brush, zoom or pan.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format x positions on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the series key when there is more than one series.
